Product complexity

Features, workflows, user types and business rules all influence the shape of the build.

User roles

Admin, customer, vendor, partner and employee experiences require different permissions and flows.

UX and design

A template interface requires a different level of work than a fully custom product experience.

Integrations

Payment gateways, CRMs, ERPs, communication tools and third-party APIs affect scope.

Infrastructure and security

Scale, availability, authentication, access control and audit requirements determine the technical foundation.

Ongoing development

A continuous improvement partnership is scoped differently from a one-time product build.

Product development process

From idea to live product — then the next improvement.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Understand the business, users, product idea and objectives.

    Output: Product requirements and project direction.
  2. 02

    Define

    Identify the core features, user journeys, MVP scope and technical requirements.

    Output: Product scope and development roadmap.
  3. 03

    Design

    Create user flows, wireframes and the visual product experience.

    Output: UX/UI designs and design system.
  4. 04

    Build

    Develop the frontend, backend, APIs, database and integrations.

    Output: Functional product.
  5. 05

    Test

    Test functionality, usability, responsiveness and performance.

    Output: Production-ready application.
  6. 06

    Launch

    Deploy the application, configure infrastructure and implement analytics.

    Output: Live product.
  7. 07

    Improve

    Use user feedback, product data and business priorities to improve the product.

    Output: Product roadmap and optimisation cycle.

Frequently asked questions

How much does it cost to build a SaaS product?

SaaS products typically start around ₹3L and can scale with product complexity, integrations, user roles, infrastructure and scope.

How much does an MVP cost?

MVP engagements typically start from ₹1.5L, with many focused products falling in the ₹1.5L–₹3L range depending on scope.

How long does an MVP take?

A focused MVP can typically take around 4–8 weeks. Larger or more complex products require a longer cycle.

Can you improve an existing SaaS product?

Yes. Feature development, UI/UX improvement, integrations, performance optimisation and ongoing support can follow a technical assessment.

Can you handle deployment and integrations?

Yes. Cloud deployment, environment setup, CI/CD, payment systems, CRMs, ERPs and other APIs can be included where needed.

Can you also help launch and market the product?

Yes. ScratchBox can extend into branding, product launch, content, performance marketing and growth.
